record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the six-block dilation schedule [1,2,4,8,1,2] with [1,2,4,1,2,4]. Repeated local-to-medium causal processing may better capture dependencies in histories with median length 7–8 while reducing sparse long-range convolution. Retain six blocks, kernel size, residual scale 0.5, features, embeddings, history/readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Synchronize architecture metadata and predictor construction; train one model per category.
